input.summary: Narrow one-sided 24-month no-hire to a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a one-sided no-hire covering all Vendor employees for twenty-four months with no carve-out; our position is no non-solicit on Customer, and Section 12.3 already confirms we give no no-hire commitment. We have narrowed this to our fallback: a mutual twelve-month non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with the usual general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs, and the hiring restriction deleted.

ops.oldText: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: 12.4 During the term and for twelve months after the end of an individual's involvement in the Services, neither Party shall knowingly solicit for employment any personnel of the other Party who were directly involved in performing or receiving the Services. This Section does not restrict either Party from engaging or hiring any person who responds to a general advertisement or other recruitment activity not specifically targeted at the other Party's personnel, or who approaches that Party on an unsolicited basis, and neither Party is restricted from hiring or employing any such person.
